paperTitle: Viral.izo 2.0: An Enhanced Casual Educational Game for Resource Management Against Viral Threats
centralContribution: This work presents Viral.izo 2.0, an enhanced casual educational game designed to foster resource management skills against emerging viral attacks, extending a previous version by incorporating three new game levels of progressive difficulty, three distinct virus variants with unique behaviors, two novel minigames, and a local ranking system, alongside a comprehensive User Experience (UX) assessment.

units.title: Viral.izo 2.0 Enhancements
units.summary: Enhanced educational game with new levels, virus variants, minigames, and UX ...

content.description: Viral.izo 2.0 is an enhanced casual educational game designed to foster resource management skills against viral attacks. It extends a previous version by incorporating three new game levels of progressive difficulty, three distinct virus variants with unique behaviors, two novel minigames, and a local ranking system, all supported by a comprehensive User Experience (UX) assessment.

units.whyThisUnit: This unit directly states the central contribution of the paper, detailing the core innovations and improvements of Viral.izo 2.0.

units.title: Paper Abstract
units.summary: Viral.izo 2.0 offers engaging resource management against viral threats for h...

content.description: The COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the critical need for effective health awareness and promotion, especially among children and young people. Digital games emerged as a significant tool for mental well-being and health promotion. While existing educational games address health, Viral.izo 2.0 aims to offer a more engaging and comprehensive experience by focusing on strategic resource management against evolving viral threats through an updated game design and rigorous user evaluation.

units.whyThisUnit: This provides a concise summary of the paper's context, problem, and general approach, fulfilling the requirement for an abstract element.
